items.title: Charlie Love Interview, 1960-05-10
items.q: I went I was waiting for a little show they called Overton and Senior Ragtime Minister Show... I made the last trip with him in Mississippi.

ctx.x: But this this song when I was telling you about this now I've been hoodoo. They used to sing that in all them old ministry shows long while ago. 1903. Billy Cassand used to sing that in his ministry. You remember you heard of Billy Cassand? Oh sure. Of course he's a famous man. I went I was waiting for a little show they called Overton and Senior Ragtime Minister Show. And he was he just had got by and he went on a honeymoon trip. He just went out with the show. Opened up the show. And he he thought about Bill…
